dataset.name: gharchive_2024-10-07_96h
dataset.source: GH Archive (https://www.gharchive.org/) hourly dumps of the public GitHub events timeline, https://data.gharchive.org/2024-10-{07..10}-{0..23}.json.gz
dataset.processing: streamed one hour at a time; only a compact event table is kept (time, type, action, numeric actor id, numeric repository id, flags: org-owned, bot actor, actor is repository owner, repository-creation, push size); raw files are deleted after extraction; no logins, names or text are stored

identification.statement: Both models are observational associations in public GitHub activity. Nothing was randomized; the models predict what tends to follow, not what an intervention (for example buying stars or promoting a repository) would cause.

population: public GitHub accounts and public repositories whose events reached the public events API and GH Archive between 2024-10-07 and 2024-10-10 UTC; bot accounts (login ending in [bot]) excluded from units

model_deep_engagement.unit: the first star (WatchEvent 'started') by a non-bot actor on a repository the actor does not own, within the window
model_deep_engagement.label: 1 if the same actor produces a ForkEvent, IssuesEvent, IssueCommentEvent, PullRequestEvent, PullRequestReviewEvent or PullRequestReviewCommentEvent on the same repository after the star (later in archive order) and within 24 hours of it
model_deep_engagement.features: computed from the 24 complete hours before the star's hour: repository counts of stars, forks, issue events, pull-request events, pushes, releases, all events; repository created within the window (and hours since creation); repository owned by an organisation; actor counts of all events, stars, forks, issue events, pull-request events, pushes; actor's prior events on this repository; hour of day (sin, cos). Counts enter as log1p; no history means a count of 0.

splits.test: stars in D2 12:00-24:00 (labels observed until the end of D3)
splits.user_level_holdout: test stars by actors with no star in train or validation, reported separately
splits.strict_time_check: the kept model class refitted on D1 00:00-12:00 stars only (all label windows end before the test period starts) and evaluated on the same test split

candidates.description: L2 logistic regression (C = 1.0) on standardised features
histogram gradient-boosted trees (learning rate 0.1, 31 leaves, min 100 samples per leaf, L2 1.0, at most 300 iterations, early stopping on validation log loss with patience 20)

model_repo_growth.unit: (repository, day d) for repositories with at least one star or fork by a non-bot actor on day d, or created on day d
model_repo_growth.target: number of stars by non-bot actors on day d+1
model_repo_growth.features: day-d counts of stars, forks, issue events, pull-request events, pushes, releases and all events; stars on day d-1; created on day d; organisation-owned. Counts enter as log1p.

splits.train: d = D1 (target D2), repositories whose seeded hash falls in 80%
splits.validation: d = D1, the other 20% of repositories (repository-level holdout)
splits.repository_level_holdout: test rows whose repository is absent from train, reported separately

candidates.description: rule baseline: next-day stars = a * today's stars + b, a and b fitted by Poisson likelihood on train
Poisson regression with log link on the log1p features (L2 alpha 1e-4)
histogram gradient-boosted trees with Poisson loss (learning rate 0.1, 31 leaves, min 100 samples per leaf, at most 300 iterations, early stopping on validation Poisson deviance with patience 20)

metrics: distributional checks from negative-binomial sampling with a dispersion fitted on train: share zero, share >= 10, quantiles 0.5/0.9/0.99/0.999, KS statistic on log1p counts

descriptive_reference.statement: Not fitted: for repositories created on D1, the share with at least one non-owner star and the mean cumulative stars by hour since creation (0-48 h). Reported as an empirical reference curve for later simulator validation.

comparison_rule.selection: for each model, keep the candidate (baseline included) with the lowest validation primary metric
comparison_rule.confirmation: on the test split compute every candidate's primary metric and the paired-bootstrap 95% interval (200 resamples) of (kept - other); worse_model_kept counts candidates for which the interval lies entirely above zero. It must be 0; otherwise the card says so and the better model replaces it.

extrapolation_limits_to_document: four days of one autumn week in 2024: no seasonality, no long-run adoption
public events only; GH Archive can miss events when the API drops them
stars are inflated by automation and star farming; stars are not evidence of useful adoption
24-hour conversion window: later deep engagement is invisible
observational: no causal effect of promotion or ranking
GitHub's population (skewed to particular regions, languages and professional developers) is not the simulator's population
